args.title: Update BASE_URL in src/notifications/templates.ts to use production URL
args.body: Issue 4201 reports that the password reset email links to 'http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=...'. This occurs because the BASE_URL is set to use the localhost as a fallback for the PUBLIC_URL environment variable. The change proposed in this pull request is to modify the BASE_URL assignment so that it uses a production URL instead of localhost, allowing the links in the password reset emails to work correctly. This should replace the fallback with a more suitable production URL to prevent similar issues.
